summary.en: Designs and coordinates a global product network, with assembly concentrated among contract manufacturers in Asia.
summary.zh: 设计并协调整个全球产品网络，组装环节集中于亚洲的代工制造商。

supplyChainStrength.en: Tight control over design, supplier qualification and launch timing across a highly coordinated network.
supplyChainStrength.zh: 在高度协同的网络中，对设计、供应商认证与上市节奏保持严格控制。

supplyChainRisk.en: Dependence on concentrated assembly capacity and on a small number of critical component suppliers.
supplyChainRisk.zh: 依赖高度集中的组装产能，以及少数几家关键零部件供应商。

summary.en: A pure-play foundry that manufactures advanced chips designed by other companies.
summary.zh: 纯晶圆代工企业，为其他公司设计的先进芯片提供制造。

keyActivities.zh: 与客户协同的产能规划

supplyChainStrength.en: Process technology and scale that few alternatives can replace at the most advanced nodes.
supplyChainStrength.zh: 在最先进制程节点上，其工艺技术与规模几乎无可替代。

supplyChainRisk.en: Extreme geographic concentration, plus long lead times for the equipment and materials it depends on.
supplyChainRisk.zh: 地理分布高度集中，且所依赖的设备与材料交期很长。

summary.en: Runs one of the most studied production systems, built around levelled production and supplier co-development.
summary.zh: 运营着被广泛研究的生产体系，核心是平准化生产与供应商协同开发。

supplyChainStrength.en: Long-standing supplier relationships and production discipline built to absorb disruption.
supplyChainStrength.zh: 长期稳定的供应商关系，以及为吸收冲击而建立的生产纪律。

supplyChainRisk.en: Deep multi-tier supplier networks make visibility beyond the first tier difficult after a shock.
supplyChainRisk.zh: 多层级的供应商网络很深，冲击发生后难以看清第一层以外的状况。

summary.en: Moves containers across ocean networks and operates the terminal capacity at both ends of the route.
summary.zh: 经营跨洋集装箱运输网络，并在航线两端运营码头吞吐能力。

keyActivities.zh: 内陆运输与多式联运衔接
货物可视化与单证处理

supplyChainStrength.en: Control of both vessels and terminals lets one container be tracked door to door.
supplyChainStrength.zh: 同时掌握船舶与码头，使一个集装箱可以实现门到门追踪。

supplyChainRisk.en: Network reliability moves with freight cycles and with disruption at a few key chokepoints.
supplyChainRisk.zh: 网络可靠性随运价周期波动，也受少数关键咽喉节点中断的影响。

summary.en: Uses retail scale as a supply chain instrument: distribution centres, cross-docks and supplier data sharing.
summary.zh: 把零售规模当作供应链工具来使用：配送中心、越库作业与供应商数据共享。

keyActivities.zh: 供应商协同与数据共享

supplyChainStrength.en: Very high replenishment frequency supported by a dense distribution network and shared demand data.
supplyChainStrength.zh: 凭借密集的配送网络与共享的需求数据，实现极高频率的补货。

supplyChainRisk.en: Thin margins and high volume leave little slack when demand swings faster than replenishment.
supplyChainRisk.zh: 薄利与高销量意味着，当需求波动快于补货节奏时几乎不留缓冲。

summary.en: Supplies the energy and feedstock that sit at the very start of many industrial supply chains.
summary.zh: 提供位于众多工业供应链最上游的能源与原料。

supplyChainStrength.en: Integrated control reaching from extraction through refining to bulk logistics.
supplyChainStrength.zh: 从开采、炼制到散货物流的一体化掌控。

supplyChainRisk.en: Exposure to geopolitical events, long-distance shipping routes and commodity price swings.
supplyChainRisk.zh: 受地缘政治事件、远距离航运线路以及大宗商品价格波动的影响。

summary.en: Provides the software and cloud infrastructure that many planning and coordination systems run on.
summary.zh: 提供众多计划与协同系统所依赖的软件和云基础设施。

supplyChainStrength.en: Software and cloud platforms sit upstream of many supply chain planning systems.
supplyChainStrength.zh: 软件与云平台位于众多供应链计划系统的上游。

supplyChainRisk.en: Data centre expansion depends on long-lead equipment and on regional power and construction capacity.
supplyChainRisk.zh: 数据中心扩张依赖交期长的设备，以及各地的电力与施工能力。

summary.en: Builds the lithography equipment that advanced chip production cannot run without.
summary.zh: 制造先进芯片生产所不可或缺的光刻设备。

supplyChainStrength.en: A bottleneck supplier of equipment with almost no substitute at the most advanced nodes.
supplyChainStrength.zh: 在最先进制程节点上几乎没有替代品的瓶颈型设备供应商。

supplyChainRisk.en: Capacity is limited by a very small number of highly specialised upstream suppliers.
supplyChainRisk.zh: 产能受制于数量极少、高度专业化的上游供应商。

summary.en: Manufactures across many plants and brands, sourcing through wide multi-tier supplier networks.
summary.zh: 在众多工厂与品牌之间组织制造，通过广泛的多层级供应商网络采购。

keyActivities.zh: 电池与零部件供应开发

supplyChainStrength.en: Platform sharing across brands gives purchasing scale and flexible plant allocation.
supplyChainStrength.zh: 跨品牌共用平台带来采购规模，也让产能分配更灵活。

supplyChainRisk.en: Complex multi-brand sourcing makes it hard to trace exposure deep in the supplier tiers.
supplyChainRisk.zh: 多品牌采购结构复杂，难以追查供应商层级深处的敞口。

summary.en: Runs express, forwarding and contract logistics networks across more than one transport mode.
summary.zh: 跨多种运输方式运营快递、货代与合同物流网络。

supplyChainStrength.en: Breadth of modes and geographies lets customers shift between speed and cost.
supplyChainStrength.zh: 运输方式与地理覆盖广，客户可以在时效与成本之间切换。

supplyChainRisk.en: Network performance depends on labour availability, air capacity and customs throughput.
supplyChainRisk.zh: 网络表现取决于劳动力供给、航空运力与通关效率。

summary.en: Contract manufacturer that assembles electronics at scale for brand-owning customers.
summary.zh: 为品牌方客户大规模组装电子产品的代工制造商。

supplyChainStrength.en: Ability to scale assembly capacity and labour quickly for new product launches.
supplyChainStrength.zh: 能为新产品上市快速扩张组装产能与人力。

supplyChainRisk.en: Concentrated production sites and a workforce model sensitive to demand swings and local disruption.
supplyChainRisk.zh: 生产基地集中，且用工模式对需求波动和当地扰动较为敏感。

summary.en: Combines retail with a fulfilment network it largely operates itself.
summary.zh: 将零售与主要由自身运营的履约网络结合在一起。

supplyChainStrength.en: Inventory is placed close to demand, supported by its own fulfilment and delivery network.
supplyChainStrength.zh: 依托自营的履约与配送网络，把库存布置在贴近需求的位置。

supplyChainRisk.en: Very large seasonal swings require rapid capacity changes in both labour and transport.
supplyChainRisk.zh: 极大的季节性波动要求人力和运力都能快速调整。

summary.en: Manufactures medicines under strict quality and temperature controls across a global network.
summary.zh: 在严格的质量与温控要求下，通过全球网络生产药品。

supplyChainStrength.en: Tight process control and validated production lines that are slow to replace.
supplyChainStrength.zh: 严格的工艺控制与经过验证的生产线，难以被快速替代。

supplyChainRisk.en: Cold-chain dependence and lengthy validation make rapid source or site changes difficult.
supplyChainRisk.zh: 对冷链的依赖加上漫长的验证流程，使更换供应来源或厂址变得困难。
